label: Fibromyalgia: A Multifactorial Pain Disorder.
summary: Fibromyalgia represents a complex chronic pain condition in which patients experience widespread pain accompanied by fatigue and a broad range of physical and psychological symptoms. Diagnosis relies on symptom-based diagnostic criteria that lack objectivity, making it difficult to properly diagnose and treat.
